title: supera configuration
description: Per-repo configuration for supera. Written by /start, read by every skill.

baseBranch.description: Branch worktrees branch off and PRs target.

buildCommand.description: Shell command to build the project.

debugMode.description: When true, ship pauses after each step to report status and ask for confirmation or error recovery. Can also be activated per-run via SUPERAS_DEBUG=true env var without changing config.

lintCommand.description: Shell command to lint the project.

testCommands.description: Test commands keyed by layer (e.g., unit, integration, e2e). /start detects what exists — only keys the repo actually has are emitted. Unknown keys are ignored by skills.
